notes.title: Pinewood Valley Version 1.1.5 IS NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
​Thank you to everyone for the feedback we received!

With the help of feedback, we were able to improve/fix the Following
-Previous Performance/FPS issues (this update should provide a much more stable experience)

-A minor bug that would cause a cutscene to trigger again.

-A Certain area in the map had zero Collison causing the player to fall through the map.

-General Audio in settings now controls Players and NPCs Voices Volume.


These changes are now live with the Beta Version 1.1.5 Update
